result.summary: Completed CLM-018 read-only rights-language surface inventory. Found sources table already has license + isCommercialUseAllowed columns but no typed registry reads them; most public surfaces (/licensing, /terms, /api-docs, embeds) already correctly distinguish free access from reuse rights. Real gaps: footer/about lead with unqualified headline framing before qualifying text, CiteAccordion and embed attribution say nothing about reuse rights, and no validator checks rights language at all. Wrote smallest-honest-fix recommendation that doesn't depend on DAT-003's future manifest.
